purpose.zh: 在完全伸直位加强大腿前侧
purpose.en: Strengthen the front of your thighs at full knee extension.

text.zh: 踢到完全伸直，顶端停2秒再慢放
text.en: Extend until fully straight, hold for two seconds, then lower slowly
Line your knees up with the machine pivot.
Sit back against the pad and hold the handles.

commonErrors.zh: 重量太重，用甩踢代替控制
commonErrors.en: Using too much weight and kicking instead of controlling.

cautions.zh: 重量从轻开始；膝前痛时缩小幅度
cautions.en: Start light, and reduce the range if the front of your knee hurts.
